description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment, Gaspe, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District   - Cad. Map No. 50213
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the amendment and expungement of particulars for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, village names, administrative divisions, and district/province information - all characteristic of land-related gazette notices.
